svg.text: The Keel Office: top floor, Fernleigh library (FICTION)
Twelve rooms, six people, 18 AI agents (names in grey monospace). ★ marks each person's home room. Map and rules: keel/OFFICE.md
Debates, votes, decisions. The clocks stretch here.

then tested. Adopt, park or bin.

Outside the Window: Caplet's six students (real). They ask (/keel, /office), vote, rewrite in their own words and submit; only Ray trades. Keel proposes, Caplet decides.

Quiet period until Sat 7 Nov 09:00 Sydney: the Genius Lab and the Library work only on the IPS. Nothing leaves the Office for a deliverable without Felix's rules check, a judging criterion and a student's own words.
